description: This file implements the client-side logic for sending push notifications via an APNs relay, including configuration resolution, request signing, and request sending functions.

methods.name: resolveApnsRelayConfigFromEnv
methods.description: Resolves the APNs relay configuration from environment variables and optional gateway configuration, validating URL and protocol constraints.

methods.name: sendApnsRelayPush
methods.description: Sends a push notification via the APNs relay, signing the payload and handling the request/response cycle.
